up: Find all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5726934 that have a canonical SMILES representation. Return the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the preferred name (pref_name), and the canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles) for each compound. Ensure the query joins the document to the compounds and then to their structures to retrieve the SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726934'
